summary: Palmer Square Capital BDC Inc. filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing management's unaudited estimate of net asset value per share of $13.34 as of September 30, 2026, signed by CFO Jeffrey D. Fox on October 13, 2026. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanic is stated; the filing is an ordinary periodic NAV estimate for the NYSE-listed BDC (ticker PSBD), not a special situation. Watch for the next quarterly valuation update and any subsequent NAV-versus-market-price spread, but no deal or risk-arb angle exists here.
